mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT P.PER_CODE FROM USER_ROLES UR INNER JOIN ROLES R ON UR.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID INNER JOIN ROLE_PERMISSIONS RP ON R.ROLE_ID = RP.ROLE_ID INNER JOIN PERMISSIONS P ON RP.PER_ID = P.PER_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.ENABLED = TRUE AND RP.ENABLED = TRUE AND P.ENABLED = TRUE
